text:
Yes, there are several, but what fits depends on your Model Y's year.

**2020 to early-2025 Model Y (older console)**
Plug-in 8.66" Android rear displays are the usual choice. They work while driving and add rear climate and seat-heat controls.
- **Cheapest listed:** Teslahubs Rear Display Ultra, $269.99 (2019-2024 only), per [Dealectric's comparison](https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen). I didn't get a direct product page for it.
- **Tesery 8.66":** $359 for the 2020-2025.03 Model Y ([buy here](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla)). It has CarPlay and a 30-day return policy. Reviews are mixed (4.7 stars overall, but some owners report lag, a screen that keeps entering child-lock mode, and app updates that never finish).
- **Amazon:** many 8.66" units run about $210-$330, such as [this results page](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen). Ratings are mostly 3.2-3.9 stars with few reviews, so I'd be cautious. The $210.99 Tlyard has only one rating.

**2025-2026 Model Y (Juniper)**
Most trims already include Tesla's own 8" rear touchscreen, and the add-ons above won't fit. Options from the same comparison:
- **Standard trim without a rear screen:** Hansshow H86, $399.99 ([details](https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen)).
- **Any trim but the Standard:** Hansshow 18.5" flip-down, $1,049.
- **Cheapest fix:** a Tesery seat-back tablet mount, $19.99. Check that your trim is supported.

**Parked movie nights**
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in projector screen and roof sunshade, but it's not a display, so you need a separate portable projector. It's for parked use only. It is designed for the 2025-2026 Model Y, and on 2020-2024 cars it works in roof mode only. Dealectric lists a code, CJ10, that it says saves about $12.

**My pick:** For kids on road trips in a 2020-2024 car, I'd start with the Tesery ($359) for its return policy and CarPlay, or the cheaper Teslahubs if you want to save money. In a 2025+ car with a built-in rear screen, a $19.99 tablet mount is likely all you need.

What year and trim is your Model Y? I can narrow it to one pick.
